listings.description: LIBRE Berry Crush Eau de Parfum Fruitee Freedom has a scent. LIBRE Berry Crush is a bold floral fruity fragrance that reimagines the iconic LIBRE lavender with the juicy sweetness of crushed raspberries. Sweet yet daring, fresh yet indulgent, this addictive scent captures the essence of freedom—freshly crushed. The Scent Fresh raspberry bursts through LIBRE’s signature floral heart, blending aromatic French lavender with luminous Moroccan orange blossom. A creamy solar coconut accord melts into warm vanilla, amber, and musks, creating a vibrant yet sensual trail. A fragrance made to savour. Fragrance Notes Floral Fruity Top Notes: Mandarin Oil, Raspberry Accord, Lavandin Heart Provence Heart Notes: Diva Lavender Heart Provence, Living Orange Flower Ourika, Orange Flower Absolute Morocco, Solar Coconut Accord Base Notes: Vanilla Bourbon Absolute, Dry Amber Accord, Musks The iconic LIBRE bottle is reimagined in vibrant berry-red hues, accented with gold chains, an asymmetrical black cap, and the signature Cassandre logo—bold, radiant, and unapologetically feminine. Available as an eau de parfum fruitee 30, 50 and 90ml.

listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum - New for 2026 A warm spicy amber fragrance from Dolce&Gabbana, created for men. Deep, refined and intensely charismatic, The One For Men Parfum blends vibrant spices, rich amber accords and smooth tobacco into a sophisticated masculine signature. The fragrance opens with the contrast of spicy black pepper and vibrant Tarocco orange, creating a fresh yet magnetic introduction. At the heart, labdanum brings a rich amber intensity with a dark resinous warmth that adds depth and sensuality to the composition. As the scent develops, tobacco emerges in the base, leaving behind a warm, smooth and enveloping trail that feels elegant and unmistakably masculine. Amber Spicy | For Men Key notes are Black Pepper, Tarocco Orange, Labdanum, Tobacco Available as an parfum spray in sizes 50 and 100ml.

Goldfield & Banks Mystic Bliss Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Goldfield & Banks Mystic Bliss Eau de Parfum - New for 2026 A comforting gourmand aromatic fragrance from Goldfield & Banks, created for women and men. Inspired by the shimmering beauty of the Aurora Australis above Tasmania, Mystic Bliss captures the stillness of wilderness landscapes through soft fruits, aromatic botanicals and warm woods. The fragrance opens with the fresh clarity of native Australian Kunzea paired with the soft sweetness of fig and cassis, creating a luminous and subtly fruity introduction. At the heart, cardamom and clary sage bring aromatic warmth and gentle spice, while orris adds a smooth powdery elegance that enhances the fragrance’s comforting character. As the scent settles, cedarwood, incense, patchouli, immortelle and Australian sandalwood create a warm woody base with smoky and softly resinous facets that linger beautifully on the skin. Created by perfumer Florian Gallo under the direction of Dimitri Weber, Mystic Bliss evokes calm, mystery and quiet indulgence with a soft hypnotic trail inspired by Tasmania’s pristine landscapes and glowing southern skies. Gourmand Aromatic Key notes are Australian Kunzea, Fig, Cassis, Cardamom, Orris, Immortelle, Cedarwood, Incense, Australian Sandalwood It is available as an Eau de Parfum 50ml and 100ml Spray.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Moss Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: A bright aromatic aquatic fragrance from Goldfield & Banks, created for both women and men. Fresh, clean and effortlessly uplifting, this best-selling scent captures the carefree rhythm of coastal Australia with its blend of citrus, marine greens and soft woods. The fragrance opens with a crisp fusion of Italian lemon and Australian coastal moss, delivering a sparkling, oceanic freshness. At the heart, sage and geranium bring an aromatic, slightly green elegance that enhances the scent’s natural clarity. As it settles, a smooth base of cedarwood and white musk adds depth and longevity, leaving a clean, sunlit trail. Aromatic Aquatic | Unisex Key notes are Coastal Moss, Lemon, Sage, Cedarwood, White Musk It is available as an Eau de Parfum 50ml and 100ml Spray.

listings.description: NEW for 2026 - Intuition Intense from Aramis A deep and captivating woody aromatic fragrance from Aramis, created for men. Rich, confident and undeniably addictive, this intensified interpretation of the original Intuition blends fresh spice, smooth aromatics and a luxurious leather base for a powerful, modern signature. The fragrance opens with the cool freshness of juniper berry, lifted by the sharp energy of black pepper for a crisp, invigorating start. At the heart, lavender is softened by the honeyed warmth of osmanthus, creating a smooth and refined aromatic core. As it settles, creamy vanilla and oakwood blend seamlessly with Cuirissima LXR leather, delivering a deep, sensual and long-lasting trail. Woody Aromatic | For Men Key notes are Juniper Berry, Black Pepper, Lavender, Vanilla, Leather It is available as an Eau de Parfum 50 and 100ml Spray.
